limitations: No browser automation or physical GalaxyS23/iPhone14Pro GPU/FPS/temperature measurement.
B inherits the original1mXZ opacity field and is height-independent. Unrepresented subcell thin geometry is not newly detected.
The wall-front lantern reduction is deliberate; existing static torch light, R/Gvisibility and source material appearance are retained.
No geometry/model/LOD/texture-resolution/resource manifest changes. Player8K/backgroundmax4K remain policy-invariant.
Actual geometry and cache verification; image decode/transcode and image GPU memory are excluded.
The real WASM decoder runs via a local in-process test adapter; browser worker scheduling, context restoration and driver behavior are not measured.

Player8K manifest is checked and retained player-anchor identity is exercised. The full player image allocation, boss/transform lifecycle, portal input and UI are the parent agent's independent scope.
Stable object counts are not a process heap/RSS/VRAM measurement and do not establish phone thermals or FPS.
Warmer cache removes repeat geometry decoding; AssetContainer import, setup and image/GPU work can still take time. No phone loading-speed improvement is inferred from this fixture.

A geometry decoder which permanently never resolves remains an unbounded release dependency in this design. Controlled-late completion passing does not prove such a driver/worker stall cannot happen. No unreviewed timeout/forced termination was added.
